title: Kettle Ridge
hook: Carry an absurdly large kettle to a summit picnic, counterleaning through near-falls to arrive with the tea still inside.
audience: Physical-comedy and movement-challenge players who enjoy recoverable mistakes and quick retries.
core_loop: Climb one ridge; balance the load through steps and gusts; recover a tip or spill tea; rest at a checkpoint; finish; retry for a full kettle or faster arrival.
score_notes: See action-trends.md. All current phase and product confidence remain low.

inspiration.connection: Hiking supplies the summit outing and awkward shared picnic load. The game borrows the experience to create a solo movement challenge.
inspiration.evergreen_promise: Readable balance, saved near-disasters and route mastery should carry the game without trend attention.
inspiration.current_timing: Historical source growth or current expansion is recorded separately; September search slope and future peak are unverified.

commercial_hypothesis.condition: Genre/price evidence and a worthwhile finished experience within the work budget are both required. These are test prices, not selected prices or sales forecasts.

prototype_envelope.scope: One-day movement and balance prototype, three fresh players for ten minutes. Continue if two deliberately recover a near-tip and explain the action, and two request another attempt. Hold if failures feel arbitrary or one completion exhausts the appeal.

production_envelope.scope: One fixed-side-view 8–12-minute authored ridge, three checkpoints, a kinematic hiker, one explicit balance model, simple tilt-based tea loss and challenge medals.
production_envelope.note: Includes prototype, original modest art/audio, finite content, controls/settings/save, packaged Windows QA and draft store media. Calendar onboarding/review, recruitment and unforeseen rework are separate. Estimate is not demonstrated.

cash_assumptions.note: Existing tools assumed. No purchases or cash allocation. Steam fee and optional assets remain separate planning inputs in the run.

support_estimate: Allow 1–2 owner hours for launch-month triage/review, plus agent fixes as needed; actual burden unknown.

evidence.claim: December 2025 global platform report: hiking clubs grew 5.8 times in 2025. Clubs are not unique hikers; baseline and exact cutoff absent. June 2026 repeat is not new growth.
Superflight: USD 2.99 regular/current, 11,043 Steam-purchase reviews, 96.4% positive. Compact movement mastery reference; production time and unit sales not established.
PEAK: USD 7.99 regular/current, 298,067 reviews. Its co-op and larger content package are outside this scope.
Developer announcement June 25, 2025 reports two million copies sold in nine days. Exact realized prices not disclosed. Public announcement HTML directly inspected by independent scout.
Wandering Trails: USD 4.99 regular/current, three Steam-purchase reviews, one positive. A nature setting and larger landscape alone do not establish commercial appeal.

risks: PEAK's actual sales are heavily confounded by co-op, content and studio reputation.
The trend report emphasises real-world movement and less screen time.
Convincing control and readable recovery may exceed the work budget.
A short scenic course needs replay value, not just medals added to pad length.
evidence_limits: Desk research only. No own playable build, competitor hands-on test, measured organic conversion, target-player willingness to pay or validated production time. Current names are working titles without clearance.
next_test: One-day movement and balance prototype, three fresh players for ten minutes. Continue if two deliberately recover a near-tip and explain the action, and two request another attempt. Hold if failures feel arbitrary or one completion exhausts the appeal.
decision_reason: Shortlisted for a distinct physical-comedy option with a clear clip; higher implementation risk and weaker transfer from the hit comparator.

decision_history.reason: Shortlisted for a distinct physical-comedy option with a clear clip; higher implementation risk and weaker transfer from the hit comparator. Research only; no game selected.
